==Acquisition==
*Talk to [[Gedrel of Ascalon]] [Vanguard Herald] in [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]] after attaining the first rank of the [[Ebon Vanguard rank|Ebon Vanguard title]].

==Notes==
*This cannot be equipped on the [[skill bar]]. While a [[character]] displays the Ebon Vanguard title, this effect is applied to that character and all of their [[hero]]es.
*The additional armor against Charr is subject to the [[Effect stacking|armor stacking]] cap; however, the adrenaline gain is not. 
{{Anomaly|You only receive the energy for killing Charr that grant you [[experience]].}}

==Trivia==
* This is the only title skill that provides a benefit outside of its campaign, since it can be used against the Charr in [[Ascalon]].
* The [[skill icon]] shows [[Captain Langmar]].
* [[w:Rebel_yell|Rebel yell]] was a battle cry used by Confederate soldiers during the American Civil War; it is also the name of a  [[w:Rebel_Yell_(song)|song]] by the English rock musician, Billy Idol, perhaps named after the [[w:Rebel Yell (whiskey)|whiskey]] of the same name.
